relations.subject: Sigrid Erna Anna Westphal-Hellbusch
relations.evidence: From 1935 studied Anthropology, Geography and Psychology at Berlin. Ph.D. 1940.

relations.subject: Sigrid Erna Anna Westphal-Hellbusch
relations.evidence: Then worked at Staatliches Museum für Völkerkunde 1940-45.

relations.subject: Sigrid Erna Anna Westphal-Hellbusch
relations.evidence: in 1951-53 Professor there. She was living in West Berlin and in 1953 left the East German university.

relations.subject: Sigrid Erna Anna Westphal-Hellbusch
relations.evidence: Then she was PD from 1956, apl. Professor 1959 and from 1964 ord. Professor  of Ethnology at Freie Universität Berlin, until 1970
